page.layout: One printed page. Running text at top, paragraph of full width. Below it, one table with six columns (Ind., An.Iul., Lit.dom., Nabon., Feriae., Christi.), with two blocks of rows separated by a rule. Line of numbers at the foot, right.

main_text.p: Nicæna ponitur ad vltimum diem Martii, vbi nouilunii Paschale indicat: hinc si inclusiue numerentur dies XIIII, descenditur ad 13 Aprilis, feriam Mercurii, circa quam plenilunium est conspectum: itaq; Dominica die proxime subsequenti, hoc est, 17 Aprilis celebratum est sanctū Pascha, vt vult Abul Haffumi[?].
main_text.l: Ind. | An.Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriae. | Christi.

page.notes: The Feriae column is printed to the right of the Nabon. column; the "Nou." entries stand in the Feriae area beside the rows where they occur. The Christi. column is set in two groups: 1069–1077 and 1078–1092. The line "1 1138" at the foot is a trailing figure of the table. "Haffumi" is uncertain; the scan is faint.
